description.describe_ch: 公司治理涵蓋公司組織型態，公司經營管理以及公司法規，公司組織型態包括：設立、營運、解散、董事會、及聘任經理人的管理。公司管理部份包括：企業的目標管理、組織結構的設計、領導模式的分析、業務通路的設計、公司控制、業務績效的評估及公司文化的建設。公司法規部份包括：公司法、證券交易法、銀行法、貿易法、金融控股公司法等等。公司治理可說是商學院的重點基礎課程，學習到本課程可應付千變萬化的商場行為，並使學生在就業或經營事業方面成為專業經理人。
description.describe_eh: Covering company operation scheme state, Corporate management as well as company rule, The company organizes the state to include: Sets up, transport business, dismisses, the board of directors, And appoints the manager the management. The corporate management part includes: Enterprise's goal management、Organizational structure design、Leadership pattern analysis、The company controls and the achievement achievements appraisal、Corporate culture construction. The company rule part includes：Law of corporation, card volume exchange law, banking law, trade law, financial control method…。The corporate management may say is business school's key foundation curriculum, Studies this class to be possible to deal with the ever changing business dealing, And causes the student becomes the commercial master in the employment or the management enterprise.
